protocol.model_identity_limit: Mutable alias; official page declaration, not verified fixed weights. Both arms regenerated contemporaneously.
protocol.price_basis: Official peak cache-miss input/output rates, USD per million tokens; cache/off-peak savings not assumed in reserve.
protocol.comparison: Only Q8 response format differs; Q9 absolute in both; contemporary control regenerated.
protocol.candidate_gate: Exploratory continuation only: paired-person Q8 W1 upper95<0, Q8 center point no worse, both Q9 weighted center/W1 points no worse, Q8 and Q9 validity>=99%; no automatic upgrade.
protocol.truth_isolation: Only archived roster/P/E/previous prompts parsed in prepare; current targets hashed, never read.
limits: Four previously inspected development months; no independent validation.
Current national returner population is not represented by a fresh probability sample here.
Archived original survey weights retained as sensitivity only; primary Q8 equal-person.
Two API generations do not increase independent people; mutable alias may differ from old batches.
No Q9 negative-delta repair; no clipping, normalization, forced direction or fixed update size.
Historical CE/news may be retrospective; conditional A experiment, not strict B.

primary_view: Q8 equal people/months/repeats; Q9 guard uses archived survey-weight sensitivity.

paired_intervals.scope: Exploratory unadjusted paired person clusters, months/repeats kept together; not time-generalization intervals.

notes: No correction of invalid replies. Human scores are reused from frozen evaluation; new model vectors use the same scorer.
All-arm/both-repeat common support; macro and individual metrics are distinct; repeats are not extra people.
Reused baseline cost is historical, excluded from this batch estimated_actual_cost_usd.

q8_independent.scope: Conditional on inspected months; repeated generations clustered with person. Not time-generalization or causal intervals.
